AGENTS.md

These rules apply to all work in this repository.

Project goal

MedNova is an R package for medical research task planning and R script generation.

The package must: - accept user-provided data objects and a task description - return a recommended workflow - return recommended functions to call - return a runnable R script as plain text

The package must not: - execute the generated analysis - silently modify user data - depend on a source package directory at build time

Current scope

Version 0.1.0 supports only these tasks: 1. propensity score matching 2. logistic regression 3. Cox regression 4. bulk RNA differential expression 5. Mendelian randomization 6. diagnostic modeling

Implementation rules

  • Keep the implementation minimal, conservative, and easy to read.
  • Prefer base R in package code where practical.
  • Generated scripts may reference external analysis packages, but MedNova itself should only generate text and structured guidance.
  • Do not auto-run generated code with eval(), source(), or similar mechanisms.
  • Keep templates under inst/templates/.
  • Keep catalogs under inst/catalog/.
  • Add roxygen2 doc skeletons for exported functions.
  • Preserve a standard R package layout.

Collaboration rules

  • Make small, reviewable changes.
  • Do not introduce unnecessary abstractions in the first version.
  • If a future task needs a source R package as reference, treat it as read-only input and keep MedNova independently installable.
